title: Work In Progress: summary strip info icons work as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "Work In Progress" in the left list.
  3. Point at the first info icon in the summary strip at the top.
  4. Move the pointer away.
  5. Point at the same info icon again.
  6. Click it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 3:

  • its explanation appears.

Step 4:

  • it disappears.

Step 5:

  • it appears.

Step 6:

  • it disappears. With a mouse, pointing opens the explanation and a click closes it, as before the release. On a touch screen, a tap opens it and a second tap closes it.

Why this matters: The shared info icon was changed for the aging reports.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/work-in-progress/WipSummaryStrip.vue:39-44; app/src/components/ts/reporting/shell/ReportInfoIcon.vue:1-29. V1 code, quoted: `<ReportInfoIcon :text="member.figure.tooltip" ... size="14px" />`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-202) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
